title: ACh aaPanel Customizer
name: ach_customizer
ps: Native aaPanel customization with paginated site and domain inventory, plugin-owned baseline comparisons, PHP-FPM policy and opt-in witnessed WordPress-triggered recovery, Status Pages, Nginx and FastCGI Cache tools, and Activity diagnostics. Operator decisions use concise, nonblocking advice for acceptable risks; existing authorized actions and their actual results remain visible. Write adapters depend on the target's real capabilities. Unattended no-loss Hosts cleanup and general Production qualification are not included.
author: AChWorks
